meta.title: Mise-en-scène — Lighting, Color, Staging, Design
meta.purpose: How everything within the frame carries meaning. The system uses this to make images intentional.

lighting_styles.effect: bright, even, low contrast; upbeat, safe, comedic, clean
dark, high contrast, deep shadows; tension, mystery, drama
extreme light/dark; painterly drama, moral duality
triangle of light on cheek; classic portrait depth
key + fill + rim; standard modeled, dimensional look
subject dark against bright bg; mystery, iconic shape, isolation
halo separating subject from bg; warmth, nostalgia, ethereal
light from in-scene sources (lamps, windows, neon); realism + mood
warm, long shadows, soft; nostalgia, beauty, transience

color_schemes.effect: contrast with less tension than pure complementary

color_psychology.meaning: passion, danger, love, violence, urgency, power
calm, sadness, cold, isolation, trust, technology
nature, growth, envy, sickness, the uncanny
skin-tones pop against cool backgrounds; the modern blockbuster look

staging_blocking.effect: actors on multiple planes = dynamic, hierarchical, deep world
order, confrontation, duality (e.g., two chairs facing = self vs self)
blocking toward camera = assertion; away = retreat/loss

production_design.effect: objects carry theme (a chess king = stakes; dentures = mortality/humor)
environment mirrors inner state (empty autumn park = solitude + twilight of life)
costume encodes character, era, arc (color shifts track change)
